headline: 9 Solana accounts catalogued across stake pool, token mint, admin roles, validator, and reserve; no GitHub repo or audit PDF verified.

findings.text: D1: Solscan explorer search surfaced the token mint gateMurAxe4YFoUR6J63gXGKtkbTfdkMdLjZrCmThFP labelled 'Gate Wrapped SOL (gtSOL)' and the validator vote account 2HQ5YHuw8cR1erRYZmemDmQVpfEMCjAvwU7V4fgdemJB labelled 'Gate Earn Vote Account'. No additional name-tag search was possible via direct Solscan search handler (Solana explorer does not expose the same search API as Etherscan); addresses sourced from linked Solscan URLs on Gate proof-of-reserve and SolanaCompass pages.

D2: Protocol website is https://app.sanctum.so/explore/gtSOL (blocked). Gate proof-of-reserve page at https://www.gate.com/proof-of-reserve/gtsol lists the on-chain contract address (token mint) and validator address. No canonical 'deployed contracts' docs page with a full address table was found; gate.com/proof-of-reserve/gtsol is the closest equivalent.

D3: Gate proof-of-reserve page references an 'Audit Report' button link but the PDF URL was not resolvable in this run. No audit_links were provided in the per-protocol context. No audit PDF was successfully fetched or scoped.

D4: No GitHub repo is recorded in protocol.github and none was discoverable via search or the gate.com website fetch. The gate.com page references 'View Open-Source Contract Code' but the destination URL was not resolvable in this run. GitHub discovery failed.
D5: Protocol operates on Solana only (single chain). No multi-chain enumeration required.

D6: The stake pool at 31Mwyr8Qof3LjB7Nn8fuWk6HcGVJCTYFYU3bAmW9fcL1 lists 1 active validator (epoch 1015) — 2HQ5YHuw8cR1erRYZmemDmQVpfEMCjAvwU7V4fgdemJB (Gate Earn Vote Account). Validator list storage account GJm76N2zP317dNL5iw53PUndMSdaMnqJGZLUvSecpUFA is recorded. No factory pattern applies.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: stake pool (pool), token mint (token), manager (admin), staker (admin), stake deposit authority (admin), pool withdraw authority (admin), validator list storage (other), manager fee account (treasury), reserve stake (pool), validator vote account (other).
D8: All 9 addresses in admin_addresses trace directly to fetched URLs (SolanaCompass stake pool page and Gate proof-of-reserve page). No snippet-only sightings remain.

rationale.verdict: Walked gate.com proof-of-reserve page and SolanaCompass stake pool stats page; catalogued 9 Solana accounts. Direct fetch of app.sanctum.so was blocked; no GitHub or audit PDF was accessible. Grade is unknown because this is a discovery slice.

protocol_metadata.about: Gate SOL (gtSOL) is a liquid staking token issued by Gate (gate.com) on the Solana blockchain, built on Sanctum's stake pool infrastructure. Users stake SOL to receive gtSOL, a yield-bearing receipt token whose redemption value grows over time as on-chain staking rewards accumulate. The underlying SOL is delegated to Gate's own validator (Gate Earn Vote Account) via the sanctum-pools on-chain program, with a 5% rewards fee and 0.10% withdrawal fee. gtSOL can be redeemed for SOL at any time after a standard Solana unbonding period, and is also usable across Gate exchange products and DeFi protocols.
